change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Mobile .custom-message margin-left:-40px is now stale and pulls the message over the icon
findings.body: The old `padding: 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` on `.small-action-desc` is replaced by `padding: 0 1.5%`. `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:516-523` still sets `.small-action .small-action-desc .custom-message { margin-left: -40px; }`. That offset only made sense against the 4em left padding. With a ~1.5% padding, the custom message (the cooked text under a small action such as a close or archive with a message) now starts about 40px left of the description. It overlaps or clips against the `.topic-avatar` icon, which is 45px wide. Remove or retune the mobile override together with this change. Also check `.small-action.time-gap .topic-avatar { margin-top: -5px }` at mobile/topic-post.scss:530, which assumed the old vertical padding.

findings.title: .small-action-desc is shrink-to-fit in the new flex row, so the floated delete/edit buttons no longer sit at the right edge
findings.body: `.small-action` becomes a flex container, so `.small-action-desc` is a flex item sized to its content. It has no `flex: 1` or width. The template (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/small-action.hbs:5-9`) puts the delete and edit `<button>`s inside the desc. They are styled `float: right` at lines 306-310. Before, the desc was a full-width block (the container is 755px wide on desktop, `desktop/topic-post.scss:730`), so the buttons floated to the far right of the row. Now they float to the right edge of a content-width box, right next to the text. Short descriptions also shrink the box, and `.custom-message` text wraps at a narrower width. Give `.small-action-desc` `flex: 1` (with the needed prefixes, or add a mixin) to keep the previous layout. Also, `align-items: center` now vertically centres the icon against a multi-line block when there is a `.custom-message`. Check that this is the intended look.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits a non-existent property and mis-prefixed values
findings.body: `-ms-align-items` (line 121) is not a real property in any IE/Edge version. IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align` (line 120), and IE11 supports unprefixed `align-items`. Remove it. The 2009 (`-webkit-box-align`) and IE10 (`-ms-flex-align`) syntaxes also use different keywords (`start`/`end` instead of `flex-start`/`flex-end`). Passing `flex-start` or `flex-end` to this mixin later would silently produce invalid declarations for those engines. Only `center` and `baseline` are used today, so this is latent.

contracts.action: Header `.contents` becomes a flex row (logo `.title`, `.extra-info-wrapper` order 2, `.panel` order 3 with margin-left:auto) instead of floats
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous layout: `.title` float:left, `.panel` float:right, and `.extra-info-wrapper` (overflow:hidden block) filling the space between the floats. `header.hbs` still renders `contents clearfix` with logo, panel and extra-info as direct children.
contracts.before_after: Before, floats positioned logo and panel and the extra-info block took the remaining width. After, flex positions them: the extra-info item is content-sized with overflow:hidden and can shrink, and the panel is pushed right by the auto margin. The `clearfix` :before/:after pseudo-elements become zero-size flex items, which is harmless. The home-logo component's class `title` is the flex item, and mobile `.title` still caps its size. Floats inside `.panel` are unchanged.
contracts.visible_effect: Header logo, docked topic title and icons are laid out by flexbox, with vertical centring from align-items:center.
contracts.failure_mode: Browsers without flexbox support would fall back to block layout, but prefixed fallbacks are emitted. No JS or async involved.

contracts.action: .small-action converted to a flex row with new padding on .small-action-desc
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous layout: floated `.topic-avatar` beside a full-width block `.small-action-desc` with 4em left padding. Mobile overrides and the desktop width still target the old layout.
contracts.before_after: Before, the desc was a block, so floated buttons reached the right edge and the mobile -40px custom-message offset matched the 4em padding. After, the desc is a content-sized flex item with 1.5% padding, and the mobile offset and button alignment no longer match (see findings).
contracts.visible_effect: Small-action rows (closed, archived, split and so on, plus time gaps) change vertical alignment and spacing. Delete/edit buttons and mobile custom messages are misplaced.
contracts.failure_mode: No runtime failure; silent visual regression.

contracts.action: Badge bullet and extra-info-wrapper tweaks (badges.css.scss mixin swap, removal of bullet margin-top, line-height 1.5)
contracts.equivalent_path: Same `.badge-wrapper.bullet` rule previously used unprefixed `display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline`. `#topic-title .title-wrapper .badge-wrapper.bullet` keeps its own margin-top.
contracts.before_after: The bullet rule is equivalent plus vendor prefixes. Inside the header, `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper.bullet` loses margin-top:5px and gains line-height 1.5 from the wrapper.
contracts.visible_effect: Slight vertical shift of the category bullet in the docked header.

summary: The flexbox mixins are fine, but the `.small-action` conversion leaves two regressions. The mobile `.custom-message` still has `margin-left: -40px`, which assumed the old 4em padding. The floated delete/edit buttons now sit next to the text instead of at the right edge, because `.small-action-desc` is no longer full width. The header flex change looks sound. The `-ms-align-items` line in the mixin is a non-existent property. I read the files and the related templates and overrides, and ran nothing.
